story_type: oiled pelican netted from a boat during an oil spill
hook: An oiled pelican adrift in the Gulf, and one net to reach it.
narration: This brown pelican was coated in oil and drifting alone in the Gulf of Mexico.
It was June fifteenth, twenty ten, and the crew wore white protective suits against the oil.
They were U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service personnel, and they went after it in a small boat.
Oil mats a bird's feathers, so they stop shedding water and holding in heat, and the bird struggles to fly.
The pelican kept paddling just out of reach.
[short pause] Then the net swung out over the water.
outcome: The crew netted the pelican and lifted it into the boat.
title: Oiled pelican netted in the Gulf
description:
On June 15, 2010, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service personnel rescued an oiled brown pelican in the Gulf of Mexico.

Footage: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service video by Kim Betton, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/315563/pelican-rescue-us-fish-and-wildlife-service-personnel
